meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成 GitHub PR 的代码讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要向同事或客户解释代码改动
copy.tagline_en: Turn a GitHub PR into a code-change explainer video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to explain code changes to non-technical stakeholders

howto.what: 它会读取你给的 GitHub 合并请求(PR)的代码改动、提交记录和文件,理解变更后自动生成带旁白和画面的代码解释视频,最终输出视频文件。不截图网页,只用贡献者头像。
howto.when: 当你提供 PR 链接、owner/repo#N 或指出当前仓库中的某个 PR,并要求把它做成讲解视频时触发。它只处理代码变更,不用于产品宣传或非 PR 主题。

say.text: 把这个 PR 链接的代码改动做成一个讲解视频
say.note: 它会拉取该 PR 的 diff 并开始规划。

say.text: 为 owner/repo#123 做一个新功能展示视频
say.note: 它会按编号获取 PR 并生成脚本。

say.text: 给当前仓库里的这个 PR 做个重构讲解视频
say.note: 它会识别当前仓库的 PR 并制作视频。

howto.what_en: Turns a given GitHub PR into a code-change explainer video: reads the diff, commits, and files, then plans and renders a narrated video (changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor). No web capture; only contributor avatars are used.
howto.when_en: Triggered when given a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo to make an explainer video. Only for code changes, not product promos or non-PR explainers.

say_en.text: Make an explainer video from this PR link's code changes.
say_en.note: It fetches the PR diff and starts planning.

say_en.text: Create a feature-reveal video for owner/repo#123.
say_en.note: It fetches that PR and generates a script.

say_en.text: Make a refactor walkthrough for this PR in the current repo.
say_en.note: It detects the current repo's PR and builds the video.
